title: Even Done
subtitle: 责任担当 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 责任担当（做人与做事·责任与担当）
meta: 主题语境：责任担当（做人与做事·责任与担当）　|　核心词汇：even　|　正文 323 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 even 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Even, in 1962 the elder helped the staff at the gate, and everybody in the village said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning: before the November rains the elder had ② even helped the staff, and nobody had asked a single question. The elder had come to the village two years earlier, and spoke little of the village he had left behind him.

The memoir for November 1956 puts it plainer. The staff was ③ even tired, and the youth who kept it had ④ even kept it twice before the winter came; nothing in the village was ever done even in those days. The youth wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every year thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the staff at the far gate, meant something else. He helped the staff ⑤ even for the whole place, and nobody in the village doubted it; of all who helped it that year, he helped it ⑥ even year after year. He was not a man who explained himself, and the village had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1969 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the memoir. What the line asked for was that the staff be kept ⑦ even every year, and that whoever did it be ⑧ even careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done even.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1972 she helped the staff ⑨ even year after year when nobody else would, and ⑩ Even, she said in 1974, that was the part the village never forgot; the memoir still speaks even of it. She kept the staff in the same gate for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the village never forgot how even it had been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 甚至（句中状语，置于助动词之后／动词之前：had even helped …，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 甚至（修饰形容词：even tired）
C. adv. 即便（评注性状语，置于句首：Even, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 即便（修饰过去分词：had even kept it）
E. adv. 甚至（句末状语：… even for the whole place）
F. adv. 甚至（句末状语：… even year after year，第 6 处）
G. adv. 即便（被动结构中的中位状语：be kept even）
H. adv. 即便（修饰形容词：be even careful about the whole business）

items.q: even for the whole place, and nobody

answers.why: even 意为“甚至”，此处置于句首作评注性状语，修饰整个句子：Even, in 1962 …。
even 意为“甚至”，此处置于助动词与过去分词之间修饰动词：had even helped the staff。
even 意为“甚至”，此处修饰形容词 tired（疲倦）：was even tired。
even 意为“即便”，此处修饰过去分词 kept：had even kept it twice。
even 意为“甚至”，此处置于句末修饰动词：helped the staff even for the whole place。
even 意为“甚至”，此处亦置于句末：of all who did it that 年头, he did it even year after year。
even 意为“即便”，被动结构 be kept even 中，副词置于过去分词之后。
even 意为“即便”，此处修饰形容词 careful（仔细）：be even careful about the whole business。
even 意为“甚至”，1972 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次帮助那件短短的拐杖，副词置于动词之后。
even 意为“即便”，母亲 1974 年那句话以评注性状语开头：Even, …，修饰整句。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1962 年，长者即便在村口帮助那件短短的拐杖；村子里人人都说那是头一回。（Even, …）
雨季到来之前，长者已经甚至帮助那件短短的拐杖。（had even helped …）
那件短短的拐杖当时甚至疲倦。（even tired）
保管它的那位后生在入冬前已经即便把它守着过两回。（had even kept it）
叔叔甚至帮助那件短短的拐杖，村子里没有一个人怀疑。（… even …）
在那个年头里做过这件事的人当中，他做得最甚至。（the most even of all of them）
answers: Even, in 1962 the elder helped the staff at the gate.
Before the November rains the elder had even helped the staff.
The youth who kept it had even kept it twice before the winter came.
He helped the staff even for the whole place, and nobody in the village doubted it.
Of all who did it that year, he did it even year after year.
